intro1: Discuss the new disciple's first few days as a Christian.
intro2: Have the new Christian share their "letter to God." If the new disciple has not had a chance to write one, encourage him/her to do so.
o1a1: Review how to become a Christian.
o1b: Devoted to the Apostles' Teaching — the Word
o1b1: For a quiet time, suggest a book or theme — reading a chapter a day.
o1b2: For many, a quiet time journal is helpful.
o1c1: Discuss the purpose of each gathering: Sunday Worship Services, Midweek Services, Devotionals, Bible Talk and Discipleship Partners.
o1c2: Discuss the need to initiate relationships — to give, not just receive.
o1c3: Discuss the importance of hospitality — invite people into your home for a meal.
o1c4: Discuss the expectation to be generous in financial sacrifices on Sundays and give a benevolent offering at the Midweek Services. Read together 2 Corinthians 9:6-11.
o1d: Devoted to Breaking Bread — Communion (1 Corinthians 11:23-32)
o1d1: Discuss the purpose of bread and fruit of the vine.
o1d2: Discuss what it means to become spiritually "weak, sick and fallen asleep." How does communion prevent these conditions? (For being spiritually sick see: Proverbs 13:12)
o2a1: Discuss who the new disciple has shared with.
o2a2: Make a list of people with which to share.
o3a: Strive to learn the First Principle Studies (elementary teachings) and go on to maturity, so you can be fruitful and not fall away.
o3b: Discuss taking the First Principles Classes.
